answer: Sybil resistance emerges by binding each auction bidder to a unique staked identity, where a juniper-tier bond escrow and opal-verified credential hash prevent one agent from spawning duplicate wallets. Colluders attempting to forge parallel identities must post independent capital buffers, so multi-unit allocation weights decay as O(1/k) per linked cluster. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
